title: The L2-signature of toric hyperkahler quotients
exact_target: Compute L² signatures and suitable index formulae for toric hyper-Kähler quotients, including possible subsystem terms.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002527 (AIM-PHYSICS-0035). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, $L^2$ harmonic forms in geometry and string theory; notes by Anda Degeratu and Mark Haskins, March 2004, 21 March 2004, Hausel wrap-up programme and first step 3.

status_qualification: The assertions about concentration in middle degree and self-duality are historical source context with geometric assumptions, not newly verified universal statements. This is a third first step in the shared programme of 20002525–20002527. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
